item.title: [6.9] Global Market: ECB may pause rate hikes after December amid growth risks
item.description:
WHAT HAPPENED

European Central Bank policymakers expect to raise interest rates by 25 basis points in December to counter energy-led inflation, before pausing further monetary tightening as rising bond yields are expected to weigh on economic growth and price pressures.

WHY IT MATTERS

Signals a potential inflection point in ECB monetary policy, which carries broad implications for European equities, fixed income, and currency markets.

item.title: [6.8] Strategyproof Deep Reinforcement Learning for Online Resource Allocation
item.description:
WHAT HAPPENED

Online resource allocation faces two coupled challenges: (1) allocating scarce resources efficiently under uncertain future demand, and (2) ensuring that agents report task valuations and requirements truthfully (strategyproofness). Reinforcement Learning (RL) adapts allocation decisions through experience but does not necessarily ensure strategyproofness. Existing strategyproof RL uses a...

WHY IT MATTERS

This paper bridges deep reinforcement learning and economic mechanism design by introducing a strictly strategyproof neural mechanism for online resource allocation.
